verdict.rationale: Shopify documents and demonstrates a live Universal Commerce Protocol/MCP agent-commerce endpoint that lets agents search catalogs, build carts, and checkout without scraping — verified with real runtime probes showing a full MCP handshake, real product search results, and a real cart creation on a live Shopify store. This is exactly the documented, non-scraping agent-commerce endpoint the story asks for, with both vendor docs and independent runtime verification. Missing for 10: an end-to-end completed checkout/order placement in the probe (cart creation stopped short of order) and broader third-party (non-Shopify-authored) adoption evidence.
